newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Qantas knows no reason for share rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Qantas knows no reason for share rise.

text.p: Australia's flag carrier Qantas Airways Ltd said on Wednesday it knows of no reason for the recent rise in the company's share price.

"Qantas is not aware of any information concerning the company that a reasonable person would expect to have a material effect on the price or values of Qantas shares," Qantas said in response to a Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) query.
ASX said Qantas shares had risen to A$2.42 on Tuesday, up from A$2.09 on January 9.
"There are no matters of importance concerning Qantas about to be announced to shareholders and the market," Qantas said.
Qantas is 25 percent owned by British Airways Plc.

At 10.30 a.m. (2330 GMT), Qantas shares were two cents lower at A$2.34. Qantas shares hit a record low of A$1.79 on November 6, 1996, but during its current upswing the airline's has still to pass its previous peak of A$2.47, touched in March last year.
